Composition API: shallowRef().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { shallowRef } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Only `.value` access is reactive; the inner value is left untouched.

Composition API: triggerRef().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { triggerRef } from 'vue'`).
Forces effects depending on a `shallowRef()` to re-run.

Composition API: customRef().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { customRef } from 'vue'`).
Creates a ref with explicit control over its dependency tracking and update triggering.

Composition API: shallowReactive().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { shallowReactive } from 'vue'`).
Shallow data structures should only be used for root level state in a component.

Composition API: shallowReadonly().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { shallowReadonly } from 'vue'`).
Shallow data structures should only be used for root level state in a component.

Composition API: toRaw().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { toRaw } from 'vue'`).
`toRaw()` can return the original object from proxies created by `reactive()`, `readonly()`, `shallowReactive()` or `shallowReadonly()`.

Composition API: markRaw().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { markRaw } from 'vue'`).
Marks an object so that it will never be converted to a proxy. Returns the object itself.

Composition API: proxyRefs().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { proxyRefs } from 'vue'`).
Returns a proxy that unwraps the refs of an object, so properties can be read without `.value` — the same unwrapping `setup()`'s return value gets.

Composition API: effectScope().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { effectScope } from 'vue'`).
Creates a new effect scope. The returned object has a `run` method that takes a function and runs it, and a `stop` method that disposes every effect created inside.

Composition API: getCurrentScope().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { getCurrentScope } from 'vue'`).
Returns the current effect scope, or `undefined` if not inside an effect scope.

Composition API: onScopeDispose().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { onScopeDispose } from 'vue'`).
Registers a callback to be called when the *current* effect scope is disposed. Takes the callback only — there is no scope argument.

Composition API: EffectScope.description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { effectScope } from 'vue'`, `import type { EffectScope } from 'vue'`).
The type of the object `effectScope()` returns — `{ run, stop, active }`.
Pass `true` for a *detached* scope, which is not collected by its parent scope when that one stops.
